useVideo.setKeepScreenOn: lifecycle concern for a caller, not a demo control
useVideo.setVolume: the hardware volume keys own this
useVideo.setMuted: the native player controls expose mute
useVideo.seekTo: the native player controls expose scrubbing; seekBy is wired
useSpeech.pause: not supported by every engine; stop is the reliable control
useSpeech.voicesForLanguage: a filter for callers, not a control
useAudio.refreshInputs: runs automatically once a recording is prepared
useCamera.setLook: a label only; Looks are not applied to captures
useCamera.toggleUltraLowLightVideo: UI flag only, not reachable from a third-party app
useCamera.setZoomStep: the zoom row calls setZoom directly
useCamera.setFlash: the torch control covers the demo; flash mode is a caller choice
useMediaLibrary.requestPermission: save() and loadRecent() prompt when needed
useMediaLibrary.remove: destructive; not offered as a demo control
useGeminiNano.generate: sendMessage covers the streaming demo path
useGeminiNano.refresh: runs on mount and after a download
useGemini.setApiKey: the key card writes through saveApiKey
useVisionAI.detectFaceMesh: the vision tab demonstrates the other detectors
useVisionAI.segmentSelfie: subject segmentation is the wired demo
useVisionAI.recognizeDigitalInk: needs a stroke capture surface that does not exist yet
useVisionAI.labelImage: covered by the vision demo picker
useTPU.benchmarkTPU: wired on the Silicon compute section
useHiLight.setColor: the pulse and alert controls set colour themselves
useHiLight.setMode: set through the pulse, alert and toggle controls
